triage.description: Classify and triage a customer support ticket

should_escalate.description: Whether this issue requires manual investigation beyond standard guidance

reason.description: Brief explanation of the classification and escalation decision

missing_information.description: Information that would help resolve this ticket but is not provided

drafting.description: Draft a customer-facing reply to a support ticket

cited_policy_ids.description: Policy IDs referenced in this reply

escalation_note.description: Internal escalation note if the ticket needs human review, or null

review.description: Review a draft customer support reply for quality and safety

approved.description: Whether the reply meets all quality and safety standards

issues.description: List of specific issues found, empty if approved

suggested_fix.description: A concrete suggestion to fix the issues, or empty string if approved
